title: How a Growth Engineer Scales Up using AI
description:
Scaling a growth team used to mean headcount. Now a team of one can run the experiment program that used to take a team of five. I break down how the job changes when your agents are the team, and why your first hire should go into the highest impact work, not the leftovers.

Strategy stays human. Execution goes to agents. Analysis gets drafted by the agent, and a human calls scrap or scale. I also cover the anti-pattern of an AI written strategy doc, how to use one-on-ones to transfer your judgment, and why your agents only know the trade-offs you put in writing.

Then four scale-up plays: the experiment loop, the churn agent, the Monday digest and programmatic SEO. Fewer people, higher velocity.
